name: Onyx Protocol empty-market and unvalidated liquidation composition
summary: The attacker combined Compound-v2 empty-market exchange-rate manipulation in oETH with NFTLiquidation's trust in caller-supplied repay and collateral oTokens. Fake oTokens controlled the liquidation calculation and callback, enabling a real self-liquidation for one unit of repayment after the attacker had borrowed the other markets.
notes: The proxy's sole pre-exploit NewImplementation event selected the vulnerable NFTLiquidation artifact. Custom implementation storage slot 2 retained the same address through the exploit.
The empty-market exchange-rate and integer-rounding logic is part of oETH's immutable direct runtime, deployed in this transaction and unchanged through the exploit.

The exact onchain components record the gross assets removed or left as unrepaid VUSD debt in the selected transaction. Contemporary reports value the combined basket at approximately $3.8 million. No recovery is reported.
The USD total is a rounded published valuation of the exact onchain asset basket rather than an independently reproduced per-token price calculation.
Not the knot: one link of the conjunctive failure; the sibling with the latest age reset supplies the incident's single observation.
